content.title: Why Ocean Network Express (ONE) is a Preferred Choice for North American Businesses
content.text: ResourcesBlogWhy Ocean Network Express (ONE) is a Preferred Choice for North American BusinessesOcean Network Express (ONE) is a leader in the container shipping industry, providing a broad range of services that cater to the diverse needs of North American businesses. With a fleet of over 200 vessels and a presence in over 120 countries, ONE is uniquely positioned to facilitate seamless global trade. Here are some reasons why ONE is a preferred choice for companies in North America:Extensive Global Reach: ONE’s extensive network connects major ports across North America, Asia, Europe, and beyond, ensuring that businesses can access key markets efficiently.Reliability and Punctuality: ONE is known for its high standards of reliability and punctuality, critical factors for businesses that rely on timely deliveries to maintain their supply chain integrity.Sustainable Shipping Solutions: With a strong commitment to environmental sustainability, ONE is continually investing in eco-friendly technologies and practices, such as advanced vessel designs that reduce fuel consumption and emissions, aligning with the growing demand for greener supply chain solutions.Advanced Digital Solutions: ONE leverages cutting-edge digital technologies to provide customers with end-to-end visibility and control over their shipments, enhancing the overall efficiency and transparency of the shipping process.Enhancing Visibility and Efficiency with Shippeo’s Real-Time Visibility PlatformWhile ONE offers robust shipping services, integrating these with Shippeo’s real-time visibility platform can significantly enhance the efficiency of supply chain operations. Shippeo provides logistics providers and shippers with the tools needed to gain a comprehensive, real-time view of their cargo as it moves through the supply chain, from port of origin to final delivery.1. Real-Time Tracking Across All Modes of Transport: Shippeo’s platform allows businesses to track their shipments in real-time, across sea, road, and rail. This multimodal visibility is particularly valuable for North American businesses that rely on complex logistics networks to move goods efficiently.2. Predictive ETAs and Proactive Alerts: By leveraging advanced algorithms and machine learning, Shippeo provides highly accurate estimated times of arrival (ETAs) and proactive alerts on potential delays. This predictive capability enables businesses to manage exceptions proactively, reducing the risk of costly disruptions.3. Enhanced Collaboration and Transparency: Shippeo facilitates better collaboration between stakeholders by providing a single source of truth for all shipment data. This transparency helps improve communication, streamline operations, and ensure that everyone is on the same page, from shippers to carriers and end customers.4. Data-Driven Insights for Continuous Improvement: With access to detailed analytics and performance metrics, businesses can identify areas for improvement in their supply chains, make data-driven decisions, and optimize their logistics strategies for better outcomes.The Benefits for North American Logistics ProvidersFor North American logistics providers, combining the strengths of Ocean Network Express and Shippeo’s real-time visibility platform offers several key benefits:Improved Operational Efficiency: By gaining a clear view of the entire supply chain, logistics providers can optimize routes, reduce transit times, and improve overall operational efficiency.Enhanced Customer Experience: Providing customers with real-time updates and accurate delivery forecasts helps build trust and improve satisfaction, leading to stronger relationships and repeat business.Reduced Costs and Increased Resilience: With better visibility and predictive insights, logistics providers can anticipate issues before they become problems, allowing for quicker responses and reduced costs associated with delays or disruptions.Sustainable Supply Chain Practices: Both ONE and Shippeo are committed to sustainability, providing North American businesses with the tools needed to reduce their environmental footprint and meet their sustainability goals.Driving Success in North American Supply Chains with Shippeo and Ocean Network ExpressAs global trade continues to grow, North American businesses face increasing pressure to deliver goods quickly, efficiently, and sustainably. By partnering with Ocean Network Express and leveraging Shippeo’s real-time visibility platform, logistics providers can unlock new levels of efficiency and resilience in their supply chains.Whether it’s navigating the complexities of international shipping, enhancing operational efficiency, or meeting the growing demand for sustainable logistics solutions, the combination of ONE’s world-class shipping services and Shippeo’s cutting-edge technology provides a powerful solution for North American businesses looking to stay ahead of the competition.‍Want to stay updated with Shippeo?Latest blogs & product releases.AuthorsFrequently Asked QuestionsRelated articlesDigital Twin supply chains: What you need to knowNovember 14, 20254 min readWhat Makes a Supply Chain Antifragile?October 27, 20255 min read5 Core Benefits of a data-driven supply chainOctober 15, 20254 min read
